title: Identify the Equations
text: We have the x-axis, so $$y=0$$, $$f(x)=12-\frac{1}{3} x$$, and the line perpendicular to f(x) with the point $$(0,0)$$. This means the slope of this line is the opposite reciprocal of $$\frac{-1}{3}$$, so $$3$$, and it passes through the origin, so its $$y-intercept=0$$, giving us $$g(x)=3x$$.

title: Base and Height
text: Drawing a picture, we can see that our base starts at the origin and ends when $$f(x)=12-\frac{1}{3} x=0$$. Solve for $$x$$. The height is when f(x) and g(x) intersect.

title: Calculating Area
text: Area of a triangle $$=$$ $$\frac{1}{2} base height$$.
